description: This file contains benchmark tests for different function wrapper types (std::function, FunctionRef, AnyInvocable) using the Abseil and Google Benchmark libraries. It defines various functors and functions to measure performance overhead of function invocation.

methods.description: A simple free function used in benchmarks.

methods.name: TrivialFunctor
methods.description: A functor with an empty operator() used in performance tests.

methods.name: LargeFunctor
methods.description: A functor with additional string members to test larger functor overhead.

methods.name: CallFunction
methods.description: Template function to invoke a function with forwarded arguments.

methods.name: ConstructAndCallFunctionBenchmark
methods.description: Template function to benchmark constructing and calling a function object.
